issues.detail: The instructions do not explicitly cover error handling or edge cases such as missing environment variables or misconfiguration.
The skill is Python-specific and relies on Python packages, limiting its applicability to non-Python AI agents.

scenarios.name: expose-phoenix-with-authentication
